summary: BTQ Technologies Corp., a foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K attaching a news release announcing its selection as core post-quantum cryptography (PQC) security provider for a Korean won stablecoin proof-of-concept with iM Bank and Finger. There are no acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender, going-private, or other special-situation terms. The filing describes a commercial partnership and technology deployment, not a corporate event affecting security holders. No price, premium, board recommendation, or deal mechanics are stated. This is a routine current report on business development, not a special situation.
